- name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

## Summary

I implemented the `customerCode` assignment for `POST /api/owners`, formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner` entity** (`model/Owner.java`) — added a `customerCode` field mapped to `@Column(name = "customer_code")` with getter/setter.

3. **POST pipeline** (`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`) — inserted an `assignCustomerCode` step between `build` and `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]` so the count and the persisted code share the write transaction. 4. **OpenAPI schema** (`openapi.yml`) — added a read-only `customerCode` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct maps it by name into the GET response.

5. **DB schemas** — added the `customer_code` column to the `owners` table in all four schema files (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres); hsqldb is what the tests use, the rest kept in sync.

The acceptance test verifies both the `SMI-`/`JON-` prefix format and that two consecutive creates produce consecutive sequence numbers — both pass.
